mechanism: Carbamazepine is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer that increases haloperidol metabolism, reducing haloperidol plasma concentrations and efficacy; additionally, both drugs have CNS depressant effects and can lower seizure threshold.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and consider haloperidol dose adjustment or alternative antipsychotic; avoid if possible due to additive CNS depression and seizure risk lowering.
